=== a CP/M program at its load address
BDOS    EQU     5
WRITE   EQU     9
        ORG     100H
START:  LXI     D,MSG
        MVI     C,WRITE
        CALL    BDOS
        RET
MSG:    DB      'Hello, world',0DH,0AH,'$'
=== labels without colons in the first column
        ORG     0
LOOP    DCR     C
        JNZ     LOOP
DONE    HLT
        JMP     DONE
=== forward references
        ORG     1000H
        LXI     H,TABLE
        LXI     SP,STACK
        CALL    SUB
        JMP     START
SUB:    MOV     A,M
        RET
START:  LDA     VAR
        STA     VAR+1
        LHLD    PTR
        SHLD    PTR
        HLT
TABLE:  DB      1,2,3
VAR:    DS      2
PTR:    DW      TABLE
STACK   EQU     2000H
=== the location counter
        ORG     200H
        JMP     $
        LXI     H,$+3
        DW      $
        MVI     A,$ & 0FFH
=== a redefinable SET
N       SET     1
        MVI     A,N
N       SET     N+1
        MVI     A,N
N       SET     N*4
        MVI     B,N
=== reserved space and data between code
        ORG     40H
        JMP     MAIN
BUF:    DS      16
COUNT:  DB      0
WORDS:  DW      1,2,MAIN
MAIN:   LXI     H,BUF
        MVI     B,16
FILL:   MVI     M,0FFH
        INX     H
        DCR     B
        JNZ     FILL
        HLT
=== interrupt vectors at the restart addresses
        ORG     0
        JMP     RESET
        ORG     38H
        PUSH    PSW
        IN      10H
        OUT     11H
        POP     PSW
        EI
        RET
RESET:  LXI     SP,0
        EI
        HLT
=== expressions
V       EQU     1234H
        MVI     A,V >> 8
        MVI     B,V & 0FFH
        LXI     H,V >> 4
        MVI     A,~0 & 0FFH
        MVI     A,5 | 2
        MVI     A,(1+2)*3
=== case in names
        ORG     10H
Start:  LXI     H,Text
        JMP     Start
Text:   DB      "it's",0
=== a macro with parameters, and conditional assembly
LOAD    MACRO   REG,VAL
        MVI     REG,VAL
        ENDM
        LOAD    A,12H
        LOAD    B,3
        IF      1
        NOP
        ELSE
        HLT
        ENDIF
